content: <thought>We need to find a retrosynthetic template that, when applied to the given aromatic molecule, corresponds to electrophilic bromination (C–H to C–Br substitution). We'll search the template catalog for templates that form a C–Br bond and break a C–H bond, and that form a halide functional group. Then we will retrieve the mapped reaction SMILES and template_id from the best match.
